title: WaggleDance Leak Policy Conformance Corpus
description: Versioned, deterministic, offline fixture locking looks_like_leak_simple behavior. must_reject covers every provider/model family (bare + glued forms such as gpt4o_hit, mpt7b_case, cohere_internal_model, claude_secret_x), secrets (Bearer, sk-, AKIA), and path shapes (drive, unix roots, .. traversal, hf://, org/model:tag). must_accept lists only known-legit strings that must not trigger (language names, cache terms, branch shapes, command_center, yield_route_case, etc.). This corpus + loader test prevents regression of the shared leak detector.
provenance: hand-authored stable shapes per LEAK_POLICY spec; no wallclock, no network, no random, no real tokens or host fs paths

claim_gates.note: This is a pure test asset (conformance corpus). All claim gates are N/A and explicitly set false. No consumer may treat this as satisfying any claim gate.
